summary: In 2025, China's GDP was 19,498,039,388,042.6 USD and GDP per capita was 13,861.9702 USD, compared with 11,456,024,084,962.0 USD and 8,254.8686 USD in 2016. Inflation was 0.0596% in 2025 (2.0% in 2016), while the 10-year bond yield is null, meaning unavailable. As of 2026-09-12, the CNY/USD exchange rate was 0.149087 USD per 1 CNY, with a change of -0.021.
